item.title: California hits brakes on carpool access for low-emission vehicles
item.description: The program, which lasted nearly 24 years, allowed drivers with the colorful key-shaped sticker a pass to cruise in HOV lanes.

item.title: Soulja Boy to headline SantaCon at Belmont Park in Mission Beach
item.description: “This year will be one of our biggest yet, and we are so excited to bring SantaCon back to Belmont Park,” said Johnson.

item.title: Holiday spirit takes over Balboa Park at December Nights
item.description: Visit the December Nights website for "Know Before You” go information, including information on parking, shuttles, and free bus services.

item.title: Child dead, six seriously injured after fiery crash
item.description: The fatal collision took place Sunday, when a driver crossed over a set of double yellow lines in the San Felipe Valley, northeast of Julian.

item.title: SDG&E reports power outages in Mira Mesa, nearby communities
item.description: Power outages left several thousand homes and businesses without electrical service Monday in Mira Mesa, Scripps Ranch and Sorrento Valley.

item.title: ‘America’s outdoor downtown’: What a San Diego downtown arts district could look like
item.description: The city of San Diego, Downtown Partnership, and Prebys Foundation took a major step toward creating downtown’s first arts district.

item.title: San Ysidro man sentenced for cruelty after 34 animals rescued from flooded home
item.description: A man was sentenced Monday in a case involving dozens of animals rescued from his San Ysidro home last year, according to the San Diego Humane Society.

item.title: Library Foundation opens bookstore in Mission Hills, spotlighting local, LGBTQ+ authors
item.description: Library Foundation SD Monday opened its second bookstore, bringing an independent neighborhood shop to Mission Hills.

item.title: Sacramento pimp sentenced for conspiring to sex traffic teen in San Diego
item.description: A man who brought an 18-year-old woman to San Diego for the purpose of sexually trafficking her was sentenced Monday to 10 years in prison.

item.title: Authorities ID six people killed in San Diego County crashes over two weeks
item.description: Authorities have publicly identified six people who lost their lives over the last two weeks to San Diego County traffic accidents.
